title: Movies folder
whyItMatters: The Movies folder holds downloaded films, TV episodes and video projects that stay on the machine after sign-out.
source: Apple macOS User Guide, folders in your home folder (Movies)
notes: Counts sizes and timestamps only; no video file is opened. iMovie and other app libraries elsewhere are out of scope. Reviewed in W3-D2 (independent review, docs/research/macos-review.md).
